media.alt_text: The Quiraing rock formations and rolling green landscape on the Isle of Skye's Trotternish Ridge

caption.body:
The Quiraing on the Isle of Skye — an ancient landslip on the Trotternish Ridge. The circular walk is about 7km, takes 2-3 hours, and it's some of the most striking landscape I've seen in Scotland.

Wear layers and bring waterproofs. The weather changes fast up here.

Afterwards, The Hungry Gull near Portree reportedly has a dedicated GF fryer and GF bread for burgers — on the list to try next time. Scores 5/5 on the site's GF scale.
